verdict.rationale: BILL's S&E API docs say you can set up budgets, users and virtual cards, and the product page claims every card transaction is "controlled" and "automatically compliant," which points to budget-linked card controls. The approval-policy evidence, however, covers AP bill approvals and generic pricing-page claims, not card-spend approvals tied to budgets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-team and per-project budget allocation, card spend limits that hard-enforce budget caps, approval workflows for card spend or budget requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
